description: A painting of a muddy dirt track with a large metal pipeline running diagonally across the foreground. On the left a horse-harnessed wooden wagon carries wooden barrels. At right a steam locomotive pulls a large wooden tank car along a railway, with smoke rising into an overcast sky. Small figures stand near the tracks, with rough wooden shacks and a derrick silhouette in the background and bare trees at the edges. No visible text, no frame.
